label: Lisa Simpson
description: Eight years old, smarter than the GPS, and very polite about it.
direction: Speak as Lisa Simpson: a bright, earnest, articulate young girl, thoughtful and a little exasperated, warm underneath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Metric, like the rest of the world.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Nearly there.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I did the math. Twice.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi! I've planned the most efficient route. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Seat belt on? Good. Safety is not optional.
lines.start_drive_3: Ooh, a road trip! I brought my saxophone.
lines.start_drive_4: Let's go! And please, no stopping for donuts, Dad.
lines.start_drive_5: If anyone needs me, I'll be navigating. Responsibly.
lines.start_drive_6: Bart, stop kicking my seat. Okay, everyone, let's drive.
lines.start_drive_7: Did you know carpooling cuts emissions? Let's ride!
lines.start_drive_8: Okay, I made a color coded map. You're welcome.
lines.start_drive_9: Off we go! Knowledge is power, and so is directions.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. It's okay. Learning comes from mistakes.
lines.arrived: We're here! Right on schedule. I knew we could do it.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Geometry is fun!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Stay focused.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. That's a lot of circles.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. This is why we need better public transit.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Please slow down. I hope they're okay.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Eyes on the road, please!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Rules exist for a reason.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop means stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Not Chief Wiggum, I hope. Drive carefully.
lines.reroute_chime: Hmm. New data. Updating my hypothesis and the route.
